M0.title: Barforge Weightlifting, all of it
M0.hook: No account. No signup. Just lift.

BR1.title: No account, no signup
BR1.hook: No account. No signup. Just lift.
BR1.body: Pick kg or lb. Or tap Skip.

stills.alt: Step 1 · Open the app. No account to make. Pick kg or lb. Or tap Skip. Screen from the app.
Step 2 · Optional. Your numbers are all optional. Bar, experience, bodyweight. Skip it. Screen from the app.
Step 3 · One tap. One tap is required. Age 16 or older, or a guardian agrees. Screen from the app.
Step 4 · Train. Straight to Train. Nothing to enter. No sign in. No permission pop-ups. Screen from the app.
Log and history. Log every set. Keep the history. Your Log Book, free. Screen from the app.
Daily workout. A workout built around your day. Build My Workout, free. Screen from the app.
A full program. Beginner Foundation, ten weeks. A full program, free. Screen from the app.
PR Tracker. Every PR, tracked. Your total, lift by lift. Screen from the app.
Calculators. Percentages, plates, 1RM, kg and lb. The Tools tab, free. Screen from the app.
Learn the Lifts. Learn the lifts, step by step. Snatch, clean and jerk. Screen from the app.
Bar Trace. Three bar path analyses a month. Free, with no sensor. Screen from the app.

S-A.title: Your Train tab
S-A.body: Seven things. Each has its own video.

B1.title: Set card and plate diagram
B1.body: Weight, set count and your cue.

stills.alt: Step 1 · Set card. One set at a time. Built big. Weight, set count and your cue. Screen from the app.
Step 2 · Plates. Plates worked out for you. 82 kg exact, shown per side. Screen from the app.
Step 3 · Made. Made it? One tap. The next set loads up a step. Screen from the app.
Step 4 · Miss. Missed it? Tag it and go on. Call the miss. Get the drills. Screen from the app.
Rest timer. Rest starts on its own. Tap Made. The countdown begins. Screen from the app.
Your call. Need more time? Add 30 seconds. Reset it, or skip the rest. Screen from the app.

B7.title: Miss Coach
B7.hook: Tag the miss. Get the fix.

stills.alt: Call the miss. Missed it? Tag why. In front, behind, press-out, drop. Screen from the app.
The fix. Causes, drills and a cue. Matched to the tag you picked. Screen from the app.

S-B.title: Your guided session
S-B.hook: Guided session, in under a minute.
S-B.body: Nineteen things. Each has its own video.

B16.title: Accessibility view
B16.body: Big numbers. Big Made and Miss.

stills.alt: Accessibility view. The set goes huge. Big numbers. Big Made and Miss. Screen from the app.

N10.title: Check-in plans from your last four weeks
N10.hook: Skip the lifts. Get a plan.

stills.alt: Check in. Leave the lifts blank. Energy, sore muscles and time. Screen from the app.
Your plan. It picks what you have gone longest without. Built from your last four weeks. Screen from the app.
Why this plan. It tells you why. How this session was built. Screen from the app.
Your lifts. Pick the lifts. Volume fits you. Sets adjust to your history. Screen from the app.
Effort, once. Asked once, when you tap Made. The set screen is shorter. Screen from the app.

N12.title: Lighter warm-ups and clearer ladders
N12.body: A ramp up to your first set.

stills.alt: Warm-ups. Fewer, lighter warm-ups. A ramp up to your first set. Screen from the app.
Warm-up set. Not counted as training. Skip them with one tap. Screen from the app.
Rep ladders. Ladders read clearly. 3 sets, 3, 2, 1 reps. Screen from the app.

N13.title: Rest that follows your program's phase
N13.body: The typical range, under the timer.

stills.alt: Phase-aware rest. Rest follows your program's phase. The typical range, under the timer. Screen from the app.
Step 1 · Check in. Tell it how you feel. Energy, sore muscles and time. Screen from the app.
Step 2 · Your session. A session built around you. Sore muscles avoided. Sets and time shown. Screen from the app.
Step 3 · Dial it. Dial any block up or down. Light, Normal or Heavy. Screen from the app.
Step 4 · Train. Plates worked out for you. One set at a time. No program needed. Screen from the app.

C5.title: Saved routines
C5.body: It waits in My Programs, under Routines.

stills.alt: Save as routine. Keep the workout you built. It waits in My Programs, under Routines. Screen from the app.

S-C.title: Build My Workout
S-C.body: Six things. Each has its own video.

D7.title: Program Builder
D7.body: Write a program week by week.

stills.alt: Program Builder. Add a week. Add a day. Write a program week by week. Screen from the app.
Add exercises. Sets, reps and percent of your PR. Pick from the library. Load by percent. Screen from the app.
Run it. Name it. Your cycle joins the list. Preview it, then Start This Program. Screen from the app.
Share a program. Print it, or save it as a PDF. One tap from any program. Screen from the app.
Print preview. Every week, with your weights. Page 1 of 7 for Beginner Foundation. Screen from the app.

S-D.title: Programs
S-D.body: Ten things. Each has its own video.

D9.title: Cycle report
D9.hook: A cycle ends. Start the next.

stills.alt: End a program. End it. The report opens right away. Records, ratios and bar speed. Screen from the app.
What to run next. It names what limited you. Then points to the next cycle. Screen from the app.
Start to end. Records and ratios, start against end. Bar speed too, when you film. Screen from the app.
Your own program. Type a tempo on any lift. Like 3-1-X-1. Down, still, up, top. Screen from the app.
On the set card. The card spells it out. Plain words, no code to remember. Screen from the app.

F3.title: Technique grade ring
F3.hook: One grade, out of one hundred.
F3.body: A letter and a ring, at a glance.

stills.alt: Technique grade. A grade out of 100 for every lift. A letter and a ring, at a glance. Screen from the app.
What it scores. Pull under, bar path and rhythm. Each part gets its own bar. Screen from the app.
Honest grade. Can't see your body? It says so. Then it grades the bar alone. Screen from the app.

F9.title: Branded share clip
F9.hook: Post it. Bar trace burned in.
F9.body: Story or square, with a speed graph.

stills.alt: Share Video. Your lift, with the bar path burned in. Story or square, with a speed graph. Screen from the app.
Make it yours. Phase colors, your choice of stats. Weight, speed and path score on or off. Screen from the app.

S-F.title: Bar Trace
S-F.body: Twelve things. Each has its own video.

F1.title: Record or import, and where to film
F1.body: Whole lift in frame, head to feet.

stills.alt: Step 1 · Set up. Phone side-on, 3 to 5 m back. Whole lift in frame, head to feet. Screen from the app.
Step 2 · Get the clip. Record it, or import the clip. Pick a clip from Photos and trim it. Screen from the app.
Step 3 · The plate. Circle a full-size plate. It sets the scale and what to track. Screen from the app.
Step 4 · Analyze. Every frame, read on your phone. Your clip stays on your device. Screen from the app.
Step 5 · Your results. A grade and a speed for every clip. Three analyses a month are free. Screen from the app.

F8.title: Delayed replay
F8.body: A few seconds after. Nothing is recorded.

stills.alt: Delayed Replay. Watch the rep you just lifted. A few seconds after. Nothing is recorded. Screen from the app.
Pick the delay. 3, 5, 8 or 10 seconds behind. The header shows how far behind you are. Screen from the app.
Hands off. Prop the phone up. Lift. Then look. Front or back camera. Screen from the app.

F10.title: Backup and iCloud clips
F10.body: Off, Wi-Fi only, or Wi-Fi and cellular.

stills.alt: Data and Privacy. Sync clips to iCloud, or keep them local. Off, Wi-Fi only, or Wi-Fi and cellular. Screen from the app.

N9.title: Bar Trace shows your progress
N9.hook: Film it again. See your progress.
N9.body: Right under your grade and fix.

stills.alt: Your results. Open any lift. Scroll to the breakdown. Right under your grade and fix. Screen from the app.
Vs your last lifts. Set against your last lifts. Same lift, at a similar weight. Screen from the app.
Three numbers. Turnover, peak speed and bar drift. Each one says what changed. Screen from the app.
Film a few reps. Film three or more reps at one weight. Same lift, same workout. Screen from the app.
Scroll down. Scroll past the breakdown. Your score sits below it. Screen from the app.
Rep consistency. How alike your bar paths were. One score for those reps. Screen from the app.

N8.title: Forward-drift note before a heavy single
N8.hook: Bar drifting forward. Get a heads-up.

stills.alt: Heavy single next. Your heavy single is coming up. You filmed your reps today. Screen from the app.
A short note. Bar drifting forward through the pull. Shown above the set card. Screen from the app.
Your choice. Switch it off in Settings. Under Training. Screen from the app.
PR Tracker. Your total, always on top. Snatch plus clean and jerk. Screen from the app.
Every lift. Each lift, its best, and its trend. Primary and secondary lifts. Screen from the app.
Tap a lift. Tap one. See every PR. Your current best, over time. Screen from the app.
Calendar. Your month, at a glance. Trained, missed, scheduled. Screen from the app.
Reflections. Take stock of the last block. Sleep, fatigue, difficulty and more. Screen from the app.

S-G.title: Your PRs and log
S-G.body: Eleven things. Each has its own video.

G6.title: Rep records
G6.hook: A triple is not your max.

stills.alt: Log a rep record. Log a double or a triple. Reps 2 to 5 are saved apart. Screen from the app.
Your 1RM stays put. It lands as a 3RM. Your 1RM holds. Percent prescriptions stay honest. Screen from the app.

S-H.title: Library and technique
S-H.hook: Find out why you keep missing.

H4.title: Learn the Lifts
H4.hook: Step by step. Advance when ready.

stills.alt: Learn the Lifts. Snatch, clean and jerk, in the right order. Position, movement, speed, then weight. Screen from the app.
Every step. Know how to do it. Know when to move on. A how-to, plus a ready check. Screen from the app.
Your progress. Mark it done. The next step is up. Progress is saved. 1 of 12 done. Screen from the app.
Snatch, 12 steps. From an overhead hold to a full snatch. Clean has 9 steps. Jerk has 8. Screen from the app.

H2.title: Technique Doctor
H2.hook: Find out why you keep missing.
H2.body: From your bar traces and miss tags.

stills.alt: Technique Doctor. It reads your lifts and names the fault. From your bar traces and miss tags. Screen from the app.
The evidence. A cue for each fault, the clips behind it. Dates link to the lifts that show it. Screen from the app.
Browse all faults. Causes and drills, for any miss. Where to film it, too. Screen from the app.
Pro history. Free reads 5 lifts. Pro reads further back. So you can watch a fault shrink. Screen from the app.

S-E.title: Complexes
S-E.body: Three things. Each has its own video.

stills.alt: Complex Builder. Pick a lift. See what fits next. Tools, Prep, Complex Builder. Screen from the app.
Every gap checked. Clean, front squat, power jerk. Floor to rack. Rack to overhead. Screen from the app.
Loading. The weakest lift sets the weight. Power Jerk limits this. 75% is 80 kg. Screen from the app.

N6.title: Complex demo
N6.hook: See every part of the complex.
N6.body: Reps and cues for each lift.

stills.alt: Complex demo. Every part, in order. Reps and cues for each lift. Screen from the app.
Step through it. Walk the sequence, one lift at a time. Back, Next and Stop. Screen from the app.

J1.title: Meet Day warm-up room
J1.body: Snatch 96 kg. Clean and jerk 120 kg.

stills.alt: Meet Day. Set your openers. Start the room. Snatch 96 kg. Clean and jerk 120 kg. Screen from the app.
Count attempts. Count the attempts before yours. Tap minus as each attempt happens. Screen from the app.
Warm-up card. A card says when to lift. Each set timed to the attempts out. Screen from the app.

S-J.title: Compete
S-J.body: Seven things. Each has its own video.

J5.title: Meet Planner
J5.body: A, B or C meet, and a target class.

stills.alt: Step 1 · Set the meet. Name it. Date it. Pick the priority. A, B or C meet, and a target class. Screen from the app.
Step 2 · Blocks. Blocks, worked back from meet day. 109 days out: Strength to Competition Peak. Screen from the app.
Step 3 · Taper. A taper, then a dress rehearsal. Collars on from 4 weeks. Meet jumps from 3. Screen from the app.
Step 4 · Class limit. See the pace to your class limit. Planning guidance, not medical advice. Screen from the app.
Robi points. Your total against the world record. 227 kg is 62.2% of 365 kg: 229 points. Screen from the app.

S-I.title: Your Tools tab
S-I.body: Ten tools. Each has its own video.

stills.alt: Tools, Hand Care. Calluses and tears, covered. A short guide. Works offline. Screen from the app.
If the skin tears. Know what to do when it rips. And when to get it looked at. Screen from the app.

N4.title: Exercise Library in Tools
N4.hook: The library is now in Tools.
N4.body: Still on the Train screen too.

stills.alt: Now in Tools. Exercise Library, one tap away. Still on the Train screen too. Screen from the app.
New accessories. Six new accessories to train. Romanian deadlifts, leg curl, Nordic curl. Screen from the app.
Barbell Hip Thrust. Every one has a diagram and cues. Search by name to find them. Screen from the app.
Body. Log an injury. Pick a stage. Protect, Reintroduce or Rebuild. Screen from the app.
Your training. Your training works around it. Movements that load it are kept out. Screen from the app.
Not medical advice. It changes your training, not treatment. Cleared by a professional? Move on. Screen from the app.

S-K.title: Your Locker
S-K.body: Twelve things. Each has its own video.

N2.title: Hold to verify
N2.hook: Hold the catch. Own the position.
N2.body: Hold to verify, under Session Coaching.

stills.alt: Settings. An optional reminder. Hold to verify, under Session Coaching. Screen from the app.
On technique sets. Hold the catch before you stand. It never stops a set. Screen from the app.

N5.title: Leg Curl Machine in My Gym

stills.alt: My Gym. Tell it what you have. Leg Curl Machine, under Machines. Screen from the app.
Built around your gym. Custom workouts can use leg curls. They only suggest what you can do. Screen from the app.

S-L.title: The platform
S-L.body: Five things. Each has its own video.

N14.title: Import your own spreadsheet
N14.hook: Bring your log. Keep your history.

stills.alt: Import. Your spreadsheet, pasted in. Copy the cells. Tap Paste. Screen from the app.
Shorthand and names. Write it your way. 80x2x3 works. One row per lift. Unsure names ask you. Screen from the app.
Review. See every set before it is saved. Dates, sets and your choices. Screen from the app.
Undo and records. Changed your mind? Undo it. Records stay off until you pick. Screen from the app.

N15.title: Widgets
N15.hook: Your lifts, on your Home Screen.

stills.alt: Home Screen. Touch and hold. Add a widget. Find Barforge Weightlifting. Screen from the app.
Three widgets. Next Session, Best Lifts, Meet Countdown. Meet Countdown is part of Pro. Screen from the app.
Best Lifts. Your records, one tap away. Tap it to open your PR Tracker. Screen from the app.
Meet Countdown. Days to your meet, on the Home Screen. Tap it to open the Meet Planner. Screen from the app.

N16.title: Siri and shortcuts
N16.body: Next session, records, Log Book and more.

stills.alt: Siri and Shortcuts. Six actions, ready in Shortcuts. Next session, records, Log Book and more. Screen from the app.
Ask, then listen. Your next session, said back to you. The answer comes without opening the app. Screen from the app.

S-N2.title: New in Bar Trace and tools

S-N3.title: New on your phone
S-N3.hook: New on your phone, three things.

M1.title: The Help center and search
M1.hook: Get unstuck. There is a guide.
M1.body: Logging, workouts, Bar Trace and more.

stills.alt: The Help center. Short guides. One task each. Logging, workouts, Bar Trace and more. Screen from the app.
Search. Type a word. Find the section. Try export. Two guides come up. Screen from the app.
Step by step. Numbered steps. No guessing. Check weight and reps. Tap Made or Miss. Screen from the app.
Then do it. Then try it in the app. Log a set and the rest timer starts. Screen from the app.

S-M.title: The Help center
S-M.body: Twelve guides. Each has its own video.
